authority.source: 2026-10-17, owner research brief: "Research only, no product code. Goal: one clear model for how outside data and audience input reach graphics in a NoaCG production, written up as draft specs and draft phases for the production page plan run, with every decision left open for the owner." Drafted the same day from docs/research/2026-10-data-sources/README.md; decisions DS1 to DS20 await the owner. 2026-10-17, owner: "For me it's too difficult now to answer those questions before I actually can try it out so let's go with your recommendations. Record those as answers." and "Before we start planning the phase let's research how this should be done a bit further," with a second opinion from another agent. DS1-DS20 recorded as the recommendations; R1-R5 added from the owner's second-round input; authority stays draft until the second opinion is reviewed. 2026-10-17, current owner request: research both supplied prompts and propose a simpler data-binding, Sheets, API and audience plan for the production-page run. The second opinion and P1-P5 are proposed revisions only; existing answers and this authority status are retained. The proposed phase list is not execution authorization. 2026-10-17, latest owner clarification: audience is another kind of data; manual messages from X, SMS, WhatsApp or elsewhere and Google Sheet rows are first-class routes to a graphic. Separate Data/Audience systems are not required. YouTube matters now; Twitch remains optional. Owner: "we can add them to the plan" and "take a look at the whole plan, all phases, and get some second opinions." P1-P5 and the revised message steps are included for planning, with all phases open to independent challenge. Final agreement follows reconciliation of those reviews; this is not implementation or run authorization. Existing authority status is retained. 2026-10-17, reconciliation of the two independent whole-plan reviews (docs/research/2026-10-data-sources/synthesis-2026-10-17.md): the spec is rewritten into one proposal (the cue editor as the home, paste first, destination hygiene, a browser-led Sheet reader with a server tick, five adapters, browser-side YouTube) with phases C0-C7, track Q and their verification matrix. Draft until the owner agrees it and answers the four decisions in the synthesis section 7.
